notes.title: Junkyard Space Agency is a 'scrappier, multiplayer version' of Kerbal Space Program
notes.notes: Junkyard Space Agency is an upcoming co-op space agency simulator that the developer said is like a "scrappier, multiplayer version" of Kerbal Space Program.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/junkyard-space-agency-is-a-scrappier-multiplayer-version-of-kerbal-space-program/
